name: git-interactive-rebase-gui-tool
description: User-friendly GUI for git interactive rebasing, based on Python. A Python-based GUI tool for Git interactive rebase to streamline commit history management.

paragraphs: A clean visual GUI for git rebase -i — reorder, squash, split, rephrase, drop, and refine commit history, plus browse any branch and cherry-pick commits — all with an intuitive interface.

A Python-based Git Interactive Rebase GUI tool to visually manage commit history. Built with PySide6, this tool simplifies the complex process of rewriting Git history with a faster and more visual workflow.
Keywords: git rebase gui, interactive rebase tool, git history editor, git squash commits gui, git cherry-pick gui
features: Visual Reordering: Drag and drop commits to reorder your history, or use the Move Commit context-menu actions. In multi-select mode, drag a block of adjacent checked commits to a new position together.
Interactive Squash: Squash a commit with its neighbor, or multi-select any range of commits to squash into one — with a dedicated dialog and real-time feedback.

Multi-select Actions: Select multiple commits, then apply an action to all of them — Squash selected commits (any adjacent range), Mark selected commits, Drop selected commits (dropped one by one, newest first, with…
Smart Rephrase: Effortlessly update commit messages without leaving the app.
Instant Drop: Remove unwanted commits with a single click (with preview).

whatItDoes.text: A clean visual GUI for git rebase -i — reorder, squash, split, rephrase, drop, and refine commit history, plus browse any branch and cherry-pick commits — all with an intuitive interface.

requirements.text: Browse File Log: Open a separate read-only window showing the history of a single file, via Browse File Log… in the Repo menu or Browse file log in the file-wise view's right-click menu.
